title: Sembuwatta Lake
extract: Sembuwatta Lake is a tourist attraction situated at Elkaduwa tea plantation in the Matale District of Sri Lanka, adjacent to the Campbell's Lane Forest Reserve. Situated approximately 25 km (16 mi) from the main road, the lake is a man-made lake noted for its scenic surroundings and unique integration with the natural landscape. It is estimated to be 9–12 m (30–39 ft) deep and is fed by a natural spring, which forms a nearby swimming pool.
